scope: Chromium desktop checks against local production builds. This validates rendering, selected interactions and observed browser errors; it is not a clinical review or an exhaustive test of every interaction, browser or external link.

fullSweep.explanation: The sweep found nine remote portrait failures. Its search test started with a relative URL fixture that was subsequently corrected to an absolute URL. The failed fixture did not establish a production search defect. All failed cases were covered by the final retest.

repairs: Removed exactly nine failed photo URLs; retained the existing initials fallback and all biography/lineage data.
Corrected the search test fixture URL and verified query, result navigation and no-result behavior.

interactions: Search query, rendered result and no-result state
Compiled figure enlargement and keyboard-focus return

visualChecks: Desktop and phone homepage inspected after removal of Clinic and addition of the main landmark.
MUSA trial section inspected in the compiled clinical page.
Akio Horiguchi profile inspected in the final build: initials fallback renders without a broken image.
result: No unresolved errors observed in the full sitemap sweep plus the final affected-page and interaction retest. This is a combined verification record, not a claim that one uninterrupted final 1193-test run passed.
